data.change_summary: All acceptance criteria for tanksim-6e5.6.4 are already fully implemented and passing. The reproduction model uses a 7-factor multiplicative readiness system (temperature, condition, stability, molt_stress, density, TAN, nitrite) that drives spawning rate, hatch success, and egg dropping. All suppression thresholds are named parameters in ShrimpRuntimeParams and the neocaridina_davidi.toml species data file. Snapshots expose `repro_dominant_suppression` identifying which factor most limits breeding. Events (ShrimpBerried, EggFailure, EggDropping) carry cause codes for full traceability. The test file `reproduction_factors.rs` contains all 10 required unit tests plus 2 bonus snapshot-label tests, all passing (12/12). The full workspace test suite passes (0 failures), clippy is clean, and formatting is correct.

steps.description: Verify reproduction logic in shrimp.rs: 7-factor multiplicative readiness (temperature, condition, stability, molt_stress, density, TAN, nitrite) drives spawning, hatch success, and egg dropping

Verify all suppression thresholds are named parameters in ShrimpRuntimeParams and neocaridina_davidi.toml (density_repro_threshold_per_l, tan_repro_threshold_mg_n_per_l, no2_repro_threshold_mg_n_per_l, egg_drop_instability_threshold, etc.)
Verify snapshot exposes repro_dominant_suppression field via dominant_repro_suppression_label() and events carry cause codes (HighAmmonia, HighNitrite, LowOxygen, ChemistryInstability, etc.)
Verify unit test: test_reproduction_suppressed_above_30c (31°C vs 25°C, readiness < half, fewer reproductive outcomes)
Verify unit test: test_reproduction_suppressed_by_instability (pre-seeded instability and actual temp swing via ChangeAmbientTemperature)
Verify unit test: test_reproduction_increases_with_condition (condition 0.9 vs 0.2, frozen smoothing, readiness difference > 2x)
Verify unit test: test_density_reduces_per_capita_breeding (2/L, 8/L, 15/L with monotonic decrease assertion)
Verify unit test: test_chemistry_stress_suppresses_breeding (2 mg/L TAN and 1.5 mg/L NO2 independently verified < 70% of clean)
Verify unit test: test_egg_dropping_from_sudden_change (instability 0.8 triggers EggDropping events; stable tank control shows zero drops)
Verify unit test: test_multiple_stressors_compound (28°C + instability 0.4 combined is worse than either alone)
Verify unit test: test_all_reproduction_factors_are_named_parameters (all thresholds exist as ShrimpRuntimeParams fields with sensible defaults)
Verify integration test: test_mature_stable_tank_breeds_well (2000 hours, >=3 ShrimpBerried events, sustained population >=10)
Verify integration test: test_neglected_tank_breeding_stalls (weak biofilter + overfeeding → chemistry degradation, readiness suppression, worse outcomes than stable control)
Verify bonus tests: test_snapshot_reports_dominant_suppression (32°C → 'temperature') and test_snapshot_uses_runtime_suppression_labels (molt_stress, tan, nitrite labels)
Run full test suite: 12/12 reproduction_factors tests pass, full workspace passes (0 failures), cargo clippy clean, cargo fmt --check clean

validation_evidence: cargo test --test reproduction_factors: 12 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored
cargo test (full workspace): all test suites pass with 0 failures across ~600 tests
cargo clippy: Finished dev profile with no warnings

Reproduction logic in shrimp.rs uses 7-factor multiplicative model: temp_repro_factor, condition_index, (1-instability_index), (1-molt_stress_index), density_repro_factor, tan_repro_factor, no2_repro_factor

All thresholds are named fields in ShrimpRuntimeParams and present in neocaridina_davidi.toml: density_repro_threshold_per_l=10.0, density_repro_half_suppression_per_l=20.0, tan_repro_threshold_mg_n_per_l=1.0, no2_repro_threshold_mg_n_per_l=0.5, egg_drop_instability_threshold=0.5, egg_drop_temp_swing_c=2.0
TankSnapshot.repro_dominant_suppression field populated by dominant_repro_suppression_label() at shrimp.rs:1441, surfaced in every snapshot
EggFailure events carry cause codes: HighAmmonia, HighNitrite, LowOxygen, HighTemperature, LowMinerals, ChemistryInstability, Starvation
EggDropping events emitted with instability details when clutch loss occurs
